title: Connector QA Scenario File
description: Reference documentation for a connector's runner/connectors/<key>/qa.json certification file. The Go loader (internal/qa, decoding with DisallowUnknownFields) is the authoritative validator; this schema documents the shape for connector authors. Templating: any string value may contain {{token}} references. {{runId}} resolves to a unique per-run identifier (use it in create inputs to keep test resources unique). In teardown steps, the dot-path keys of the scenario operation's output object are available as tokens (e.g. {{issue.number}}) so teardown can clean up the resource the scenario created.

connector.description: Connector key; must match the connector's manifest.json key and the parent directory name.

scenarios.description: Named certification cases. Each scenario exercises exactly one manifest operation.

name.description: Unique, human-readable scenario name within this file.

operation.description: A real operation key from the connector's manifest.json operations map.

input.description: Input object passed to the operation. May contain {{runId}} tokens.

setup.description: Steps run (in order) before the scenario operation. {{runId}} is available.

teardown.description: Steps run (best-effort, in order) after the scenario operation to clean up. {{runId}} and the flattened scenario-output dot-path tokens (e.g. {{issue.number}}) are available.

operation.description: A real operation key from the connector's manifest.json operations map.

input.description: Input object for the step. May contain {{runId}} and (teardown only) captured output tokens.

status.description: Whether the operation is expected to succeed ("ok") or fail ("error").

errorCode.description: Expected machine error code when status is "error".

assertions.description: Checks against the operation output, each addressed by a dot-path.

op.description: Assertion operator. 'exists' tolerates a missing value (asserts presence); all others require the path to resolve.

value.description: Comparison operand for ops that need one (eq, neq, matches, type, len, gt, lt). Omitted for exists/isArray/isObject.
